## Scope

This file is a docs asset used only by docs/events-3d.html — it is NOT an entry in the kit manifest, the manifest's counts do not include it, and it is a different thing from the manifest's link-only "Three.js" pack entry (a reference clone that this repo does not copy — that pack statement is about the pack, this asset is about the docs).
